description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed use of a room in the residential dwelling for a private hire operator license issued by TFL
decision_conditions: Planning permission will not be required for a use of the nature described as part of the information submitted with this application operating from this address. As such, planning permission would not be required. For avoidance of doubt the applicant is advised that this certificate pertains to the following:
- An office within 230 Wennington Road, Rainham is to be used for record keeping, receiving telephone calls, email and electronic bookings only.
- No people will be calling at the office within 230 Wennington Road, Rainham.
- No cars would be parked or waiting near 230 Wennington Road, Rainham

However, it is worth noting that should the circumstances relating to the business alter in any respect this may change the requirements for planning permission and you should contact the Council for confirmation of these matters. The onus remains on the applicant to ensure that the development is lawful.
